title: You don't need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work | TechCrunch
summary: David Durman, a nontheistic Humanist, recently secured a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace. “Humanism is a collection of beliefs about the human experience and how humans interact with the world,” Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, told TechCrunch.
